Standard at $10 buys the do-follow plus publication within 24 hours and unlimited content updates. Premium at $39 a month adds a homepage spot, prominent placement and 12 hour processing.).

faq.question: Does Foundr give a dofollow backlink?
faq.answer: No, links from Foundr are nofollow. The site has a domain rating of 37.

faq.question: Does Foundr require a backlink to your site?
faq.answer: No, Foundr does not require a link back from your site.

faq.question: What gets you rejected from Foundr?
faq.answer: Anything that is not an AI tool, since their own copy limits the list to tools useful to AI tool creators; Anyone who needs the link followed without paying, because the free tier is nofollow by design.

source_lead: A generative-engine-optimisation directory whose free lane buys one followed link and a six month wait. Requirements, steps and what to expect.

youNeed: An account, by Google or email and password Their badge on your site, kept up and rechecked One category and at least one tag, both from their own lists An icon and a wide image, each 1MB or less
submit_steps: 1 Sign in Google, GitHub or an email and password. /submit redirects to the login until you are signed in.
2 Details Link, name, categories, tags, a short description, a Markdown introduction, then an icon and a wide image as uploads.
3 Payment Three cards. The free one sits below the two paid ones and carries the badge snippet, a Verify button and Submit to review.
4 Publish The free status moves to Pending and the card becomes 'Go dashboard and Wait'. No review window is stated.
submit_requirements: Their badge on your site 200x54 SVG, light or dark, verified live
rejection_reasons: Anyone who cannot keep a badge up permanently, since they say they recheck and unpublish Anyone who needs a listing inside six months, because their own free card states review within 180 days
gotchas: Taking the badge down later costs you the listing, not just the link, so this is a commitment for as long as you want to stay listed.
Free review is stated as within 180 days and the same card warns a free submission may be rejected for listing, so the wait does not guarantee anything at the end of it.
One tag is required and the requirement is only revealed by a red line under the field after you press Submit, not before.
The free card sits third on a step headed Payment, under the two that cost money, and its button reads Verify backlink first rather than Submit.

faq.question: How long does GEOly.net approval take?
faq.answer: GEOly.net's typical time from submission to going live is 2-3 months.

faq.question: How much does it cost to submit to GEOly.net?
faq.answer: GEOly.net has a free submission option plus paid placement (Free is $0 for one dofollow link, and the badge is its price: they say they check regularly and unpublish if it is removed, with review inside 180 days and rejection possible. Basic is $6.90 for three dofollow links with no badge and immediate listing, Pro is $19.90 for five plus a homepage spot, and a $49.90 guest post buys two contextual links in an article you write.).

faq.question: Does GEOly.net give a dofollow backlink?

faq.question: Does GEOly.net require a backlink to your site?

faq.question: What gets you rejected from GEOly.net?
